test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

The watchman has been bitten by a stray dog.

options.text: A stray dog is biting the watchman.
A watchman has bitten the stray dog.
A stray dog bit the watchman.
A stray dog has bitten the watchman.

solution:
The correct answer is "**A stray dog has bitten the watchman.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few things to keep n mind before changing a sentence from passive to active voice.
 
• The **subject **in the passive voice becomes the **object **in the active voice.
 
• In the given sentence, "**the watchman**" is the **object**(the one who receives the action) in the active voice.
 
• The **object **in the passive voice becomes the **subject **in the active voice.
 
• In the given sentence, **"A stray dog"** becomes the **subject**(the one who performs the action) of the sentence in active voice.
 
• In the active voice, we don't use the past participle of 'be' which is "**been**" with the main verb.

**The correct sentence is**: *A stray dog has bitten the watchman.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
